xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex002032026-09-0811-21-49" status="unreviewed">sngon gyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs> ltar na <rs type="school">bye brag tu smra ba</rs> rang ltar na ma chags pa'i dge ba gcig pu la yang rigs gsum du 'jog pa bzhin du | nged chos nyid rigs su 'dod pa la yang mtshungs so zhes pa dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4189">lha rje</rs> ltar na gnyis su med pa'i shes pa don dam par yod pa gcig pu la dmigs pa'i sgo nas rigs gsum du <rs type="school">sems tsam pa</rs> khyed rang 'di 'dod pa bzhin du nged chos nyid rigs su 'dod pa la yang mtshungs so zhes grub mtha' la brten nas lan 'debs pa ni dka' chos kyi lan yin skad do || </seg></TEI>
